text: To decamp is to leave a place, often suddenly, and set up somewhere else. Here, AI stars decamp from big model-makers to found their own labs.
Trifling means tiny and not worth much notice. Next to a $40bn valuation, even $200m in yearly revenue looks small.
A colossus is a giant, named for an enormous ancient Greek statue. Calling Nvidia a chip colossus says it towers over the computer-chip business.
A neolab is a new AI startup, usually founded by famous researchers who left an established lab. The word joins neo, meaning new, with lab.
Venture capital is money that investors give to young, risky companies in exchange for a share of ownership. Most bets fail, so investors hope a few win big.
A superstar is someone far more famous or skilled than their peers. Here it means top AI researchers whose names alone attract money.
Minimalist means using as little as possible. The investors' philosophy is minimalist because they back a person and an idea with almost nothing else to go on.
This quote from an early investor says his job was to judge the founder and the concept, not a detailed plan or product.
Mega-bucks is informal slang for a huge amount of money.
A boom is a period of fast growth and heavy spending in an industry. The AI boom has pulled in vast amounts of investment.
Vague means unclear or lacking detail. A vague ambition is a goal with no specific plan behind it.
Model-makers are companies that build AI models, the software trained to write, reason and answer questions, such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
Safe Superintelligence (SSI) is the neolab launched by Ilya Sutskever, an OpenAI co-founder. It says it won't ship a product until it reaches superintelligence.
Superintelligence means AI that is far smarter than humans. It is the goal SSI is aiming for, and has not been reached.
A co-founder is one of the people who started a company together.
Radical Ventures is a venture capital firm that counted 29 neolabs and tracks who invests in them.
PitchBook is a company that sells data on startups and the money invested in them.
A cohort is a group of people or things sharing a trait, studied together. Here it is the group of 29 neolabs.
An open-weight model has its learned numbers (weights) published, so anyone can download and run it. That differs from a closed model, which you can only use through the company's service.
Reflection AI is a neolab that has raised money from Nvidia and released an open-weight model called Beam.
To be hailed as something means to be praised publicly as that thing. Beam was hailed as America's answer to cheap Chinese models.
To gain ground means to make progress or become more popular, as if advancing across a battlefield.
Commercial offerings are products or services a company actually sells, as opposed to research experiments.
Code is the written instructions that tell a computer what to do. Developers can build released code into their own products.
Developers are the programmers who build apps and software.
A demo is a short showing of how something works, not a finished product. Research demos show an approach rather than serve customers.
Billed as means described or advertised as. Here the code is billed as research demos, not products.
When a startup is valued at an amount, investors have agreed on a price tag for the whole company, based on hopes for its future.
To scale up is to make something much bigger, for AI usually by using more data and computing power.
Nvidia is the company whose chips power most AI training. It also invests in many AI startups, including neolabs.
Here handed the startup funding means gave it money. It is a casual way to describe a big payment.
Mira Murati is a former OpenAI executive who founded the neolab Thinking Machines Lab.
Thinking Machines Lab (TML) is Mira Murati's neolab. It has released a service called Tinker and its own model, Inkling.
A valuation is the price tag put on a whole company, set by what investors will pay for a share of it.
To customise is to adjust something to fit a particular need. Engineers customise open-weight models for their own tasks.
Annualised revenue takes recent sales and multiplies them to a full year. It estimates yearly income if the pace holds.
A fundraising round is one batch of new investment, with the startup selling shares to investors in return for money.
OpenRouter is an online marketplace where developers can use many different AI models.
The cut-off is the line that decides who is in or out. Inkling falls just below it on the list of top models.
A traffic cop directs cars. Here it is a metaphor for a model that sends each task to whichever other model suits it best.
Ultra-cheap means extremely low in price, a big reason a model becomes popular.
Typesafe is the neolab behind Jev. It raised $40m, then $870m more this month.
Modest means fairly small. Compared with other neolab sums, $40m is modest.
A copycat copies someone else's idea or product. Copycat offerings are rivals that quickly imitate a successful model.
Here surfaced means appeared. Rivals have surfaced since Jev was released.
A breakthrough is a major discovery that makes real progress possible.
Computing power is the amount of processing a computer system can do. Training AI takes enormous amounts, supplied by chips.
To push someone into the arms of another means to leave them depending on that other party, for lack of other options.
Chips are the tiny processors that run computers. AI training needs powerful ones, mostly made by Nvidia.
AMD is a chip company that competes with Nvidia.
World Labs is a neolab founded by Fei-Fei Li, bought by AMD for $8bn in September.
Fei-Fei Li is a renowned AI researcher, founder of World Labs.
An acquisition is when one company buys another.
Here patient means willing to wait a long time for results before getting money back.
Returns are the profit an investor earns on money put in.
Backers are the people or firms who give money to support a venture.
Biotech is short for biotechnology, companies using biology to make medicines and treatments.
Milestones are checkpoints that show how far a project has come, like passing a stage of a trial.
Human trials are tests of a new medicine on people, run in phases. Passing early phases lets a biotech raise more funds.
